INT. DEAN OF STUDENTS' OFFICE - DAY

Sunlight streams into a comfortable, well-appointed office. DEAN JENKINS (50s, kind but firm, dressed in professional attire) is seated in a large, plush office chair, facing away from us. Behind her, SUN-HO (20s, Korean, wearing glasses and a crisp, but slightly rumpled, button-down shirt) is diligently giving her a back massage. He looks focused, almost too focused, on his task.

Sun-Ho's brow is furrowed in concentration, but a hint of nervousness plays around his eyes. He presses a little harder on the Dean's shoulders.

SUN-HO

Dean Jenkins lets out a contented sigh, stretching her neck.

DEAN JENKINS

Sun-Ho nods, undeterred, increasing the pressure slightly.

SUN-HO

Suddenly, the office door SWINGS open. LENA (20s, brown hair, fiery eyes, dressed casually) stands framed in the doorway, her hands on her hips, her face a mask of pure outrage. She glares first at Sun-Ho, then at the Dean, then back at Sun-Ho with disbelief.

Sun-Ho’s eyes widen as he sees her. His jaw slackens, and his hands freeze mid-massage on the Dean's back.

LENA

Sun-Ho's jaw drops further, his face a picture of utter shock and despair. He takes a step toward Lena, his hands reaching out instinctively.

SUN-HO

But Lena spins on her heel and storms out of the office, the door slamming shut behind her, leaving a stunned silence.

Sun-Ho stands there, hands still outstretched, looking utterly devastated. Dean Jenkins slowly turns in her chair, a look of polite confusion on her face as she watches him.

Gravel is a loose mixture of small stones or rock fragments. It’s usually made up of pieces that range in size from about 2 mm to 64 mm (roughly the size of a pea to a golf ball). Gravel forms naturally through the weathering and erosion of larger rocks, but it can also be crushed from bigger stones in quarries. Common Uses of Gravel: • Construction: used in concrete, road bases, and foundations • Landscaping: for driveways, walkways, and gardens • Drainage: because water flows easily through it • Railroad beds: helps keep tracks in place and drains water There are different types of gravel, like pea gravel, crushed stone, and river rock, each with its own look and use.

🎬 Sinners (2025) – Summary & Credits 📖 Synopsis Set in 1932 in the Mississippi Delta, Sinners follows twin brothers Smoke and Stack (both played by Michael B. Jordan) who return home after working for Al Capone. They plan to open a juke joint for their community's blues musician cousin, Sammie. However, their celebration turns nightmarish when supernatural forces — vampiric creatures — invade, sparking a bloody and emotional confrontation. Themes of racial oppression, cultural identity, family bonds, and musical ritual underscore the story in Coogler's genre-bending blend of Southern Gothic, horror, musical, and Western elements 🌟 Credits Director & Writer: Ryan Coogler Producers: Zinzi Coogler, Sev Ohanian, Ryan Coogler Cinematography: Autumn Durald Arkapaw Editing: Michael P. Shawver Music: Score by Ludwig Göransson; soundtrack produced by Serena Göransson in collaboration with Grammy-winning blues talents 👥 Main Cast Michael B. Jordan – Smoke & Stack, the twin brothers Hailee Steinfeld – Mary, Stack’s love interest turned key figure in the plot Miles Caton – Sammie, the gifted blues musician cousin whose music channels supernatural forces Jack O'Connell, Wunmi Mosaku, Jayme Lawson, Delroy Lindo, Omar Miller – in memorable supporting roles 🔚 Ending & Credits Scenes (Spoilers) Main Ending: Smoke sacrifices himself, killing Stack and repelling the vampiric onslaught — a thematic stand for resistance over assimilation . Epilogue Post-Credit #1: Set in 1992, an aged Sammie (Buddy Guy) runs his blues club when Stack and Mary—unaltered by time—visit. We learn Smoke spared Stack under the condition he not harm Sammie Post-Credit #2: A reflective scene shows younger Sammie performing “This Little Light of Mine” in his father’s church, underscoring his devotional connection to music
